metadata.note: Hand-authored. What runner-less checks read of GitHub (ADR-0183): .hobo/ci.json at the pull request's base branch, the run, the pull request (by the run's ref, or for a pull_request_target run from a fork, among the open pull requests from the run's head) and, for the lint check only, the commit's tarball: GitHub's API answers with a 302 to codeload.github.com, which is read without the installation token (the one interaction whose request names a host: codeload.github.com, not the REST API). Shapes from GitHub's REST documentation (pulls, actions/workflow-runs, repos/contents, repos/contents#download-a-repository-archive-tar), read 2026-11-17.
